answer.en: No, it's best not to share pizza. It can upset a dog's stomach and even lead to pancreatitis, toppings can contain garlic or onion, which damage red blood cells, and the crust is far too high in calories. Raw pizza dough is risky too.
answer.sl: Ne, pice raje ne delite s psom. Lahko mu razdraži želodec in celo povzroči vnetje trebušne slinavke, nadevi lahko vsebujejo česen ali čebulo, ki poškodujeta rdeče krvničke, skorja pa ima veliko preveč kalorij. Tvegano je tudi surovo testo za pico.

why.en: AKC lists pizza among party foods to keep away from dogs, and VCA and the ASPCA say leftovers and party food like pizza can cause stomach upset and even pancreatitis. Cheese is high in fat, and pepperoni is too fatty and spicy and risks salt poisoning. Garlic and onion, which can be in toppings and seasonings, damage red blood cells and kidneys. Pizza crust is way too high in calories and can lead to obesity. Uncooked pizza dough produces ethanol inside a dog's body.
why.sl: AKC pico uvršča med hrano z zabav, ki naj bo zunaj pasjega dosega, VCA in ASPCA pa navajata, da lahko ostanki in hrana z zabav, kot je pica, lahko razdražijo želodec in celo povzročijo vnetje trebušne slinavke. Sir je zelo masten, salama pepperoni pa je premastna in prepikantna ter prinaša tveganje zastrupitve s soljo. Česen in čebula, ki sta lahko v nadevih in začimbah, poškodujeta rdeče krvničke in ledvice. Skorja ima veliko preveč kalorij in lahko vodi v debelost. Surovo testo za pico v pasjem telesu tvori etanol.

en: Belly pain, nausea, fever, low energy or poor appetite (possible pancreatitis)
Loss of appetite or low mood after onion or garlic toppings
sl: Bolečine v trebuhu, slabost, vročina, utrujenost ali slab apetit (morda vnetje trebušne slinavke)
Izguba apetita ali potrtost po nadevih s čebulo ali česnom

what_to_do.en: If your dog got into pizza, contact your vet. If the toppings may have contained garlic or onion, don't wait to see. If your dog ate raw pizza dough, contact your vet too.
what_to_do.sl: Če je pes pojedel pico, pokličite veterinarja. Če sta bila v nadevu morda česen ali čebula, ne čakajte. Tudi če je pes pojedel surovo testo za pico, pokličite veterinarja.

child.en: Pizza is a people food. Its cheese and toppings can upset a dog's tummy, so give your dog its own treat instead.
child.sl: Pica je hrana za ljudi. Sir in nadevi lahko psu razdražijo trebušček, zato mu raje daj njegov priboljšek.

q.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo skorjo pice?

a.en: It's best not to. A vet nutritionist at Cornell says pizza crust is way too high in calories and can lead to obesity.
a.sl: Bolje ne. Veterinarski nutricionist s Cornella pravi, da ima skorja pice veliko preveč kalorij in lahko vodi v debelost.

q.sl: Je surovo testo za pico nevarno?

a.en: Yes. Uncooked bread and pizza dough produce ethanol inside a dog's body, and raw yeast dough can expand in the stomach. Contact your vet.
a.sl: Da. Surovo testo za kruh in pico v pasjem telesu tvori etanol, kvašeno testo pa se lahko v želodcu razširi. Pokličite veterinarja.
